A real-time renderer, and effects for 2D games: render sprite sheets in seconds and play them in Bevy.

**Real-time rendering**
- The viewport now draws on the GPU (with wgpu, the graphics layer Bevy uses), so big scenes, particles, smoke and fire stay smooth. If the GPU can't start, the app falls back to OpenGL.
- **Render → Render Real-Time** renders the current frame, or the Render Settings frame range, through the render camera in seconds. The frames are transparent PNGs, and MoonRay isn't needed. MoonRay is still there for final-quality renders.
- Flipbooks are now rendered on the GPU instead of captured from the screen, so the viewport doesn't need to be visible.

**Effects for 2D games**
- **Render → Export Sprite Sheet…** renders the playback range and packs the frames into one PNG, with a `.pfx.json` file giving the grid, frame count and frame rate. Empty space can be cropped away.
- The new [bevy_procedural_fx](https://crates.io/crates/bevy_procedural_fx) crate plays those sheets in Bevy: looping, once, or as one-shot effects. Re-export a sheet and a running game updates straight away.

**AI assistant**
- Before you build, the assistant shows what a typical request costs with the model you chose.
- Credit never expires: unused plan credit now rolls over to the next month.

- If the project ever ends, the code becomes open source under Apache-2.0. This is written into the license.
- Read our promise to users at [build3dstudio.com/promise](https://www.build3dstudio.com/promise). The scene file format is now [documented](https://github.com/loksangho/proceduralfx-studio/blob/main/docs/scene-format.md).
